freeze_context.note: The narrative map and headline-selection rules were frozen after training-system and integrated weight-trajectory inspection, but before the complete discovery retrieval matrix or any formal common-state, representation, intervention, hybrid, short-branch, or confirmatory output existed. This is a prospective completion lock, not a preregistration before all outcome inspection.

amendments.reason: Correct the bound paper plan to state that the completed 120-checkpoint trajectory tier used sketch-rank 0 and that exact spectra are reserved for the frozen common-state subset; no result-selection or interpretation rule changed.

Correct the bound paper plan to match the retained aggregate MTEB evidence, which supports seed-by-task but not query-level inference, and prospectively fix Bonferroni familywise intervals over all six prespecified contrasts before any confirmatory output exists.

DiscoveryHeadline.required_scope: all 24 runs, all five observed checkpoints, and all 14 decontaminated BEIR tasks
primary_outputs: per-family final mean nDCG@10 for every learning-rate point
within-family AdamW-median observed time-to-quality with right censoring
audited useful wall time, examples per second, optimizer-state size, and peak memory
DiscoveryHeadline.selection_rule: Retain every learning-rate point. A best point may be named only together with its configured learning rate and the complete within-family sweep; discovery values are exploratory and do not support a replicated optimizer claim.

CommonStateHeadline.required_scope: all 20 frozen common-state anchors after eight shared frozen-weight gradients and all 360 exact spectra
primary_outputs: per-operator effective-rank and spectral-norm ratios to AdamW
per-operator row-norm CV and top-1-percent row-energy ratios to AdamW
pairwise optimizer direction cosine under per-tensor Frobenius matching
CommonStateHeadline.selection_rule: Report DenseOn and LateOn separately and report both Muon and NorMuon. Muon spectral conditioning and NorMuon row balancing are distinct hypotheses; neither may be substituted for the other.

RepresentationHeadline.required_scope: both strict 120-checkpoint representation tiers and the 120-checkpoint/96-transition mechanism bridge
RepresentationHeadline.selection_rule: Checkpoint levels and prespecified within-run first-difference Spearman associations are descriptive. A geometry-to-retrieval claim additionally requires a matching controlled intervention or shared-start result.

InterventionHeadline.required_scope: all 20 functional anchors, all eight hybrid AdamW controls, and all 18 three-order-seed shared-start branches
primary_outputs: scale-0.001 matched-direction loss, margin, reciprocal-rank, and top-1 changes with sign reversal
hybrid-minus-native AdamW paired final task results for all four learning rates
final-stage Muon-AdamW, NorMuon-AdamW, and NorMuon-Muon short-branch contrasts
InterventionHeadline.selection_rule: A virtual step supports only an immediate directional claim. Accumulation language requires the corresponding shared-start contrast, and orthogonalization language requires the hybrid-routing control.

ConfirmationHeadline.required_scope: all six family-by-optimizer contrasts over three new seeds and 14 tasks
primary_outputs: Bonferroni familywise 95-percent interval over all six frozen contrasts
ConfirmationHeadline.selection_rule: Use only the Bonferroni familywise interval for headline sign language: call a contrast positive only when its lower bound is above zero, negative only when its upper bound is below zero, and otherwise inconclusive. Report both nominal and familywise intervals for all three optimizer contrasts in both model families; do not infer query-level significance.

result_contingent_story_map.retrieval_and_time_to_quality_gain: Spectral update conditioning transfers to retrieval under the matched controls.
result_contingent_story_map.time_to_quality_gain_but_final_tie: The optimizer changes adaptation efficiency without establishing a superior final representation.
result_contingent_story_map.loss_gain_but_retrieval_loss: Optimizer mismatch or excessive functional drift separates training-objective progress from zero-shot retrieval.
result_contingent_story_map.normuon_late_specific_gain_with_token_co: Row adaptation complements orthogonalization in a token-level scoring function.
result_contingent_story_map.geometry_change_without_function_change: Much of the parameter-space difference is functionally redundant for retrieval.

claim_boundary: The protocol fixes what must be reported and how interval signs constrain language; it does not guarantee that any optimizer wins. Discovery learning-rate points, checkpoint correlations, and integrated weight trajectories remain exploratory or descriptive. Only common-state interventions identify immediate direction effects, shared-start branches test accumulation, and validation-frozen new-seed BEIR runs support replicated optimizer comparisons.
